weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). Effective against flying foes.
At start of turn, and after unit acts (if Canto triggers, after Canto), inflicts Spd/Def-7, 【Exposure】, and【Sabotage】on closest foes and foes within 2 spaces of those foes through their next actions.
If unit or ally on the map initiates combat and defeats a foe with the【Exposure】 effect active during combat, grants Atk/Spd【Great Talent】+4 to unit and allies on the map after combat.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+15 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and disables skills of all foes excluding foe in combat during combat.
(This skill grants max of【Great Talent】+24 for unit and【Great Talent】+12 for allies.)
【Exposure】
Foe's attacks deal +10 damage.
【Sabotage】
Inflicts penalty on unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res during combat = highest penalty on each stat between unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit. Calculates each stat penalty independently.
【Great Talent】
Adds value of Great Talent (+X) to specified stats (until end of battle; max value of X is determined by the stat reaching the limit of 99, each stat calculated separately and cannot exceed max value for each skill; stat increases are not treated as Bonus effects).

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Atk.

When Special triggers, boosts damage by 70% of unit's Atk.
Reduces damage from foe's first attack by 40% during combat ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes).
If it is unit's first combat initiated by unit this turn, and if the distance from unit's space to foe's space ≤ 2, unit attacks twice during combat, but if unit can make a follow-up attack, calculates damage from unit's attacks at 80%. (This calculation stacks with other effects that calculate damage at X% such as Potent Follow.)

a.d: If attacking in Aether Raids, grants Atk/Spd+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of foe's defensive structures: ≤2 structures grants +4; 3 grants +3; 4 grants +2; ≥5 grants +1. Destroyed defensive structures are not counted.)

If attacking in Aether Raids, grants Atk/Spd+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of foe's defensive structures: ≤2 structures grants +7; 3 grants +5; 4 grants +3; ≥5 grants +1. Destroyed defensive structures are not counted.)

If attacking in Aether Raids, grants Atk/Spd+X during combat. (Calculates X based on number of foe's defensive structures: ≤2 structures grants +10; 3 grants +7; 4 grants +4; ≥5 grants +1. Destroyed defensive structures are not counted.)

At start of turn, grants【Null Foresight Snare】 to unit for 1 turn.
If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by unit or targets unit, grants【Null Foresight Snare】 to allies within 3 spaces of both unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally (including unit and that ally) after movement for 1 turn.
If unit initiates combat or is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd = number of Bonus effects active on foe + 10 (max 14; excluding stat bonuses), unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's first attack by X ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes; if Foresight Snare is active on foe, X = 15; otherwise, X = 7), and reduces the percentage of foe's non-Special "reduce damage by X%" skills by 50% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Null Foresight Snare】
Neutralizes effects of foe's【Foresight Snare】.
【Foresight Snare】
If foe initiates combat and there were no combat instances on the current turn yet (player phase and enemy phase are counted separately), triggers the following effects:
- Cancels foe's attack, completing their action.
- Inflicts Isolation and status preventing counterattacks on foe through foe's next action.
- Cancels Foresight Snare granted to your army.
(These effects trigger after Aether Raids traps but before Savior; does not trigger in Pawns of Loki).
